title: Recovery of edge assignments
statement: For a complete multipartite graph with $q$ parts of $k$ vertices each, a perfect matching, and a natural number $n$, start with an assignment of labels in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to the matching edges. Convert it to a vertex labeling by assigning each vertex the label of its matched edge, then recover an edge assignment from that labeling by choosing an endpoint representative for each edge. The recovered edge assignment is the original assignment.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching of the complete multipartite graph
